steps.label: Start from the joint table
steps.pseudocode: Start from the joint probabilities of (bedrooms, price band).

steps.label: Marginal: add across the other variable
steps.pseudocode: P(X = x) = sum over y of P(X = x, Y = y)

steps.label: The marginal distribution of X
steps.pseudocode: Do this for every x to get the marginal distribution of X.

steps.label: Conditional: we learn that Y = High
steps.pseudocode: Keep only the cells where Y = High.

steps.label: Slice out the High column
steps.pseudocode: The slice is not yet a distribution: it does not add up to 1.

steps.label: Renormalize so it adds to 1
steps.pseudocode: Divide each entry by the slice total: P(X = x | Y = High) = P(x, High) / P(High)

steps.label: Marginal versus conditional
steps.pseudocode: Compare the marginal with the conditional distribution.

steps.label: Why ML cares
steps.pseudocode: Prediction means conditioning on what was observed, then asking about the rest.
